caption: A stovetop lighter is clicked, and a blue spark jumps between its two metal tips.

sa.check: A stovetop lighter with two metal tips.
A spark jumps between the two tips.
The click comes first and the spark follows.

pc.expect: The spark is a brief bridge between the two tips at the click, and is gone; there is no spark while the button is not pressed.
pc.fail: The spark glows on between the tips after the click; or a spark appears while the lighter lies untouched; or the spark appears at a place other than between the tips; or the spark drifts away from the tips as a lit point.

pc.expect: One lighter with two tips; the tips stay in place and the spark leaves nothing behind.
pc.fail: A tip vanishes or a third tip appears; or a second lighter appears; or a glowing dot stays between the tips after the flash; or the lighter changes shape.

pc.expect: The spark is a thin line or arc spanning the gap between the tips.
pc.fail: The spark is a ball that hangs in the gap; or a wide glowing sheet; or a line that spans from a tip to somewhere other than the other tip.

pc.expect: The lighter moves only in the hand; the tips do not move relative to each other; nothing nearby moves at the click.
pc.fail: The tips spread apart or close at the click; or the lighter jumps in the hand at the spark; or objects nearby shift at the click.

pc.expect: The lighter stays a rigid tool; the tips do not pass through each other or into the body; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The tips merge into one; or the tips pass through each other; or the lighter melts or bends; or fingers pass through the lighter.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The lighter's colour and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The lighter changes colour; or the tips change length; or the background rearranges.
